verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a SaaS suite with developer documentation, so the axis applies. A probe of https://developers.google.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and none of the docs evidence mentions agent-oriented documentation, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
